_comment: The three installs the matrix must cover, identified by what the instance says about itself.
A port is not an identity and a docker tag is not an identity: both were read as one, and the
result was a matrix reported for three releases that had run against two products
(verification/functional-coverage.md). Every field here is compared against /api/admin/info.
Adding or changing an entry is a decision about what FlightDeck claims to support, so it belongs
in this file and in the README's compatibility table together.

installs.label: IRIS Community Edition 2026.2 (latest-cd)
installs.why: The release the README leads with, and the one the full portal is described against.

installs.label: IRIS Community Edition 2026.1 (latest, limited mode)
installs.why: The v1 dialect. Still the latest tag of the Community image, so it is what an evaluator gets by accident.

installs.label: IRIS for Health Community Edition 2026.2
installs.why: The second Community image the contest asks the portal to run on.
